name: Briksdal glacier walk
why: An easy track past a big waterfall to a glacier lake under the blue ice tongue of Briksdalsbreen, an arm of Jostedalsbreen.
book: Free; parking and cafe at Briksdalsbre Fjellstove. Troll cars go up in summer.
dangers: Do not walk on the ice: blocks fall into the lake.

points.name: Briksdalsbre Fjellstove
points.note: The lodge and car park in the valley.

points.name: Briksdalsbreen
points.note: The glacier tongue above a grey-green lake.
